tool.label: Memory card
tool.description: Stores or reads the self-written anti-amnesia card: the exact text the extension will re-inject when your context is truncated. Omit testo to read the current card.
tool.promptSnippet: carta_memoria: store/read the self-written anti-amnesia card
tool.guideline: If you receive the anti-amnesia bootstrap, save the card right away with carta_memoria. In autonomous cycles update lavoro_attivo at each phase change, and write "none" when the work is done.

param.testo: Complete card (full replacement). Omit to read the card, or use lavoro_attivo to update only the checkpoint.
param.lavoro_attivo: Update ONLY the existing '## {active}' section, preserving all the others. Include objective, verified state, next step and blockers. Write "none" when the work is done.
param.ruolo: Role label, informational only in the registry.
param.chiave: Key of the current Pi session (cannot point to other sessions).
param.canale_system_prompt: system prompt channel (every turn). Default OFF.
param.canale_periodico: Periodic channel (every N turns). Default ON.
param.canale_random_review: Random review channel (random cycle). Default ON.

command.description: Anti-amnesia card: /carta | /carta rigenera | /carta ogni N | /carta on|off | /carta <channel> on|off | /carta ora | /carta progetto

scope.unclassifiedHint: [Unclassified ## sections excluded: {list}. Migrate them to '{always}', '{active}' or '{topic}: ...']
scope.legacyHint: [Legacy card with no sections: if the task changes, update the card; do not act on superseded instructions.]
scope.checkpointHint: [This is a session checkpoint, not a new request: verify the real state before acting.]

intro: You have just started: full context, known role. This is the only moment when
you can write a faithful memory card for yourself. Do it NOW with the `carta_memoria` tool,
bootstrap.draftLoaded: You have loaded the cantiere DEFAULT DRAFT ({path}), which is not your own card: personalize it with the real role, session and project, then store it with `carta_memoria`.
bootstrap.detected: Data detected by Pi (use it as truth, do not invent):
keyNotice: The card will be saved with the key isolated to the current session.
Do not pass a different key; state the real role, not the full prompt text.
bootstrap.structure: Structure the card in Markdown sections. The user request may be just "continue":
bootstrap.sectionAlways: ## {always} — role, stable rules and absolute paths to re-read.
bootstrap.sectionActive: ## {active} — objective, verified state, next step, blockers, concrete files.
sectionActiveNote: Write "none" if the work is done. Update it at every phase change with
carta_memoria({ lavoro_attivo: "objective; verified state; next step; blockers" }).
bootstrap.sectionTopic: ## {topic}: word1, word2 — ARCHIVED/inactive notes, only for explicit requests.
bootstrap.topicWarning: Do not hide the active work under {topic}: it does not depend on the last prompt's words.
handoff: When the user changes task, update {active}; do not execute old plans
without comparing them with the new request and with the real state of the tools.
bootstrap.closing: Write it dense and operational: it will be re-injected verbatim when you are fogged.

inject.heartbeatFooter: [Session reminder: verify the real state before the next step.]
randomReview: [REVIEW THE CARD] Check objective, verified state, next step and blockers of {active}.
do not reactivate archived {topic} notes without an explicit request.
